title: Jegyet veszek
intro: You're at a BKV ticket office at Deák tér and need a ticket to get across town.

choices.textEn: Good afternoon! One single ticket, please.
choices.textRo: Bună ziua! Un bilet simplu, vă rog.

choices.note: With strangers at a counter use "Jó napot!" and add "kérek" (I'd like).

a2.speaker: Pénztáros
a2.textEn: Good afternoon. What kind of ticket would you like?
a2.textRo: Bună ziua. Ce fel de bilet doriți?

b.speaker: Pénztáros
b.textEn: One single ticket is 450 forints. Anything else?
b.textRo: Un bilet simplu costă 450 de forinți. Altceva?

choices.textEn: No, thank you. Can I pay by card?
choices.textRo: Nu, mulțumesc. Pot plăti cu cardul?

b2.speaker: Pénztáros
b2.textEn: Four hundred and fifty. Four-hundred-fif-ty forints.
b2.textRo: Patru sute cincizeci. Pa-tru-su-te-cinci-zeci de forinți.

choices.textEn: Oh, thanks! I'll pay by card.

c.speaker: Pénztáros
c.text: Persze. Tessék, itt a jegy. Ne felejtse el kilyukasztani!
c.textEn: Of course. Here's the ticket. Don't forget to validate it!
c.textRo: Desigur. Poftiți biletul. Nu uitați să-l validați!

choices.note: Careful: an unvalidated ticket means a fine (bírság)! Ask where to validate it.

d.speaker: Pénztáros
d.text: A metró lejáratánál, a lépcső előtt.
d.textEn: At the metro entrance, before the stairs.
d.textRo: La intrarea în metrou, înainte de scări.

oops.speaker: Ellenőr
oops.text: Jó napot, jegyellenőrzés! Ez a jegy nincs kilyukasztva.
oops.textEn: Hello, ticket inspection! This ticket isn't validated.
oops.textRo: Bună ziua, control! Biletul nu e validat.

end.text: Kilyukasztod a jegyet, és felszállsz a metróra. Szép munka!
end.textEn: You validate the ticket and get on the metro. Nice work!
end.textRo: Validezi biletul și urci în metrou. Bravo!
